Seals a digest-chained succession receipt under artifacts/upstream-succession/ with per-epoch epoch digests, coverage ratios, and tamper detection. No skill-route discovery is used.
capability.upstream-succession.name: Upstream succession plane (multi-epoch stewardship mandate)
capability.upstream-succession.proof_command: uv run python -c "from blackhole_agent.upstream_succession import builtin_upstream_succession_proof; r=builtin_upstream_succession_proof(); assert r['ok'] and r.get('mandate_met') and r.get('refresh_promotes_terminals') and r.get('multi_epoch_progressed') and r.get('seal_verified') and r.get('tamper_detected') and r.get('budget_stops') and r.get('premet_short_circuits') and r.get('rank_only') and r.get('empty_refused') and r.get('custom_stop') and r.get('refresh_drives_rework') and not r.get('used_skill_route_discovery')"

capability.utility-plane.capability_delta: Utility plane grades composed capability pipelines by outcome against frozen oracles and proves each capability's causal contribution by corruption ablation - the ledger is measured on demonstrated utility, not just liveness, without skill-route.
capability.utility-plane.description: Outcome-graded composition tasks thread multiple real ledger capabilities into multi-step pipelines (triage->memory record, security-gate->activation chain, tool-routing->triage, ledger->proposal-record gate) whose work products are compared against frozen oracles; per-capability causal ablation corrupts one step at a time and only counts when the pipeline outcome actually breaks; grades are sealed in digest-verifiable reports with tamper, ablation-fabrication, and misgrade falsification - upgrading ledger measurement from liveness (entry exits 0) to demonstrated composed utility. Dependencies stay on the durable core set so the entry survives growth-loop ledger rebuilds; the domain surfaces it grades are expressed through the pipelines and behavior paths.
capability.utility-plane.name: Capability utility plane
